FEAT.LABEL: feat
FEAT.DESC: A new feature for the user or product functionality.

FIX.LABEL: fix
FIX.DESC: A bug fix for a technical issue or unexpected behavior.

DOCS.LABEL: docs
DOCS.DESC: Documentation changes only (README, wiki, or code comments).

STYLE.LABEL: style
STYLE.DESC: Changes that do not affect the meaning of the code (white-space, formatting).

REFACTOR.LABEL: refactor
REFACTOR.DESC: A code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature.

PERF.LABEL: perf
PERF.DESC: A code change that improves performance, speed, or efficiency.

TEST.LABEL: test
TEST.DESC: Adding missing tests or correcting existing test suites.

CHORE.LABEL: chore
CHORE.DESC: Routine maintenance, tool configurations, or library updates.

BODY.LABEL: Message Body (Context & Justification):
BODY.PLACEHOLDER: Describe the motivation behind this change and contrast it with previous behavior...

FOOTER.LABEL: Footer (Metadata & References):
FOOTER.PLACEHOLDER: Reference issues (e.g., Closes #123) or breaking change notices...
